title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
FOMC: Fed holds 3.50–3.75% as expected; Warsh hawkish — Sep hike odds surge to 77%.
Oil: WTI +4.8% to $83 on renewed Middle East airstrikes (reversed 3-day ceasefire drop).
BTC ~$63.5K; crypto flat-to-slightly-down, fear sentiment into Warsh presser.
Meta + Microsoft Q2 earnings after NYSE close tonight.
